scope: Seven completed regression gates only: batch, readiness, curated, workspace, reference-management, results and scroll. Patch and tester-feedback gates are excluded.
summary: All 56 capture files are visually acceptable within their captured viewports. No fixed-control overlap, unreadable fixed label or unexpected black rendering was observed. Intentional scroll viewport clipping and long-label/path ellipsis are retained as limits.
reviewMethod: Exact original BMP hashes and dimensions were matched to each native report. Images were reviewed at original resolution through lossless PNG conversions; byte-identical counterparts are explicitly identified. No missing-control conclusion was inferred from a downscaled contact sheet.
limits: Observed hosted 96-DPI states only; no high-DPI/transitions, multiple-monitor, physical-trackpad or representative-PC acceptance is inferred.
Still images do not establish absence of flicker, unseen intermediate frames, keyboard navigation or successful actions. Functional and temporal gate evidence remains separate.
Text in scrolling panes and long list, graph or path fields may be clipped or ellipsized inside their viewport. Offscreen content is not inferred to be missing.

Workspace scenario filenames minimum or1280 are labels, not measured window sizes; capture dimensions are recorded per file. Results/DAG renders at1044x788 and legacy scroll fixtures are not initial desktop work-area containment evidence.
PrintWindow and requested-clean-redraw captures establish rendered layout, not unoccluded physical-screen behavior. Screen-capture provenance remains in each native report.
This receipt does not accept the initial CI run or candidate as a whole; patch/updater and new tester-feedback scopes require their separate recheck/evidence.
Scientific truth and provenance claims remain those of the native reports, not additional assertions derived from visual inspection.
evidenceMinimization: Focused receipt retains exact report/capture hashes and layout observations. Runtime window handles, local storage paths and redundant raw observations are omitted. Original BMPs remain in Actions artifacts.
